verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several in-app AI features that turn ledger data into insights and suggestions: plain-English questions about the business, AI Close agents that surface discrepancies, in-app 'ask AI' categorization help, runway forecasts run as AI tasks, and AR AI tasks that flag receivables needing attention. Much of the conversational insight is delivered through the external MCP and Claude rather than inside the product, which is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the in-app insights, and detailed first-party docs on the in-app plain-English Q&A (the strongest evidence for it is a marketing page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
You can see runway on the Dashboard, run a forecast as an AI task
flags the receivables that need attention before you close the month. You can work in the app, run AI tasks
